{{Otheruses|Chandrila}}
'''Chandrilan grain''' was a species of [[Grain/Legends|grain]]. The official story behind the loss of the [[Kammia]] colony in the [[Drynn system]] was that the introduction of Chandrilan grain interacted with components in the soil to create a virile contagion.
